name: Majority, categorical — the everyday happy path
purpose: Create a request that a majority of independent publishers can answer, observe it live, finalize it, close it and refund the bond.
expected_outcome: RESOLVED with the value the majority states; all five write transactions reach FINALIZED.

create_flow_inputs.step_1_question: Is the GenLayer StudioNet documentation site reachable and reporting itself online?
create_flow_inputs.step_8_review_expect: 3 sources grouping into 3 publishers, one voice each

manual_checks_after_observe: Every source shows its availability and its grounded claim with the exact passage.
The origin of each source is computed by code (github.com/genlayerlabs reads as github:genlayerlabs).
The conflict graph shows one node per publisher group.
The GenLayer lifecycle panel shows the observation transaction and the validators' votes.
notes: Replace the URLs with any pages that genuinely answer your question; sources must be public and static enough to fetch.
